problem: Consider a matrix equation ${A}^{-1}{B}^{-1}\,x=d,$ where $A$ and $B$ are $3\times 3$ non-singular matrices, while $x$ and $d$ are $3\times 1$ column vectors. Solve the equation for $x.$
worked_solution:
Pre-multiplying both sides of the equation ${A}^{-1}{B}^{-1}\,x=d$ by $A,$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1}{B}^{-1}\,x & =d \\ A{A}^{-1}{B}^{-1}\,x & =A\,d \\ {I}_{3}{B}^{-1}\,x & =A\,d \\ {B}^{-1}\,x & =A\,d.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, pre-multiplying both sides of the equation ${B}^{-1}\,x=A\,d$ by $B,$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{B}^{-1}\,x & =A\,d \\ B{B}^{-1}\,x & =BA\,d \\ {I}_{3}\,x & =BA\,d \\ x & =BA\,d.\end{aligned}
$$
